name: Inspect a bounded context export and clear it
description: A valid exported ContextSlice renders source and limitations, and clearing removes all imported content.
steps: Paste this JSON into the evidence field: {"format":"oax-evidence.v1","method":"context.preview","capturedAt":"2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z","result":{"objective":"Explain sum","path":"src/sum.ts","range":{"start":{"line":0,"column":0},"end":{"line":0,"column":8}},"documentVersion":1,"dirty":false,"excerpt":"export const sum = 1 + 2;","truncated":false,"provenance":"editor-buffer","trust":"untrusted","related":[],"limitations":["Direct callers only"]}}
Click Inspect evidence and verify src/sum.ts, the source excerpt and Direct callers only are displayed
expected: The excerpt was displayed as text; after clearing, source details are hidden, the input is empty and Evidence cleared is shown.

name: Reject invalid evidence on mobile
description: Invalid content cannot become a ContextSlice and produces an actionable visible message.
expected: Invalid evidence is visible, no source details are shown, and the page remains usable without horizontal page scrolling.

name: Do not persist imported evidence after reload
description: Sensitive imported text is not restored by local storage or the offline shell.
steps: Enter PRIVATE-TEST-CONTENT in the evidence field
expected: The input is empty and no PRIVATE-TEST-CONTENT is displayed. The page explains that the hosted viewer cannot connect to the computer's runtime.

name: Installable public shell metadata
description: The application exposes standalone installation metadata and a shell service worker without caching imported content.
steps: Inspect the linked web app manifest and its icon resource
Verify a same-origin service worker is registered after loading
If supported, switch offline and reload the page
expected: The manifest declares oAX Evidence Viewer, standalone display and a valid icon; the worker exists. When offline simulation is supported, the public shell loads without imported source.
